name: Contrie API
description: One-page extraction and reading for AI agents. Return accepted structured data or readable markdown with scoped quality, source evidence, public request progress and customer credits. Markdown is ungraded; text presence and response signatures do not establish factual truth. Plans: Free 200, Builder 10,000, Pro 40,000 credits a month; Free 10, Builder 30, Pro 100 requests per minute per account, across its keys; per-request credit cap Free 3, Builder 5, Pro 17 (rendering included).
